Prime Location

Explore the Neighborhood

We are located at 122, Jalan Petaling, right in the heart of Kuala Lumpur's vibrant Chinatown. Step outside our doors directly into a world of bustling street food, historical temples, and hip hidden bars.

What's near you

Chinatown

Petaling Street Market

Kuala Lumpur's legendary market street, bursting with local vendors, lanterns, and hidden heritage cafes. Sits directly outside our doors.

Right outside Directions
Coffee & Dining

Restoran Yook Woo Hin

A beloved heritage coffee shop located right next door. Famous for its authentic Hainanese coffee, toasted bun, and historical Chinatown atmosphere.

2 m away Directions
Transit Hub

Pasar Seni MRT & LRT

Your gateway to Kuala Lumpur. Links you directly to KL Sentral, the Petronas Twin Towers, TRX financial hub, and shopping stops within minutes.

250 m away Directions
Heritage

Merdeka Square

The historic independence square surrounded by Moorish heritage architectures, government offices, and the Sultan Abdul Samad building.

1.1 km away Directions
Iconic Landmark

Petronas Twin Towers

The world's tallest twin towers. An engineering marvel and iconic skyline feature, easily reachable by a direct LRT ride from Pasar Seni.

2.9 km away Directions
Art & Culture

Islamic Arts Museum

Southeast Asia's largest museum of Islamic art, housing rare global artifacts, tapestries, and miniature models of the world's grandest mosques.

1.5 km away Directions
